translations.web: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
translations.bsb: I call for my servant, but he does not answer, though I implore him with my own mouth.
translations.kjv: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
translations.asv: I call unto my servant, and he giveth me no answer, Though I entreat him with my mouth.
